faq.title: Allt Om
faq.subtitle: Lär dig hur tillfällig engångs-e-post fungerar och varför miljoner litar på TempMailCentral för sina integritetsbehov.
faq.question1: Vad är en tillfällig e-post eller temp mail?
faq.answer1: En tillfällig e-post (även kallad temp mail, engångs-e-post eller throwaway-e-post) är en självförstörande e-postadress som du kan använda under en kort period. Den hjälper till att skydda din riktiga e-post från spam, phishing och oönskade marknadsföringsmejl när du registrerar dig för webbplatser eller tjänster.
faq.answer2: Engångs-e-post fungerar genom att ge dig en slumpmässig e-postadress omedelbart. Alla e-postmeddelanden som skickas till denna adress visas i din tillfälliga inkorg i realtid. Efter en bestämd period (vanligtvis 10 minuter) raderas e-postadressen och alla mottagna meddelanden automatiskt.
faq.question3: Är temp mail säkert att använda?
faq.answer3: Ja, temp mail är säkert att använda för icke-känsliga syften som att registrera sig för webbplatser, ladda ner resurser eller testa applikationer. Du bör dock aldrig använda tillfällig e-post för viktiga konton som bank, eftersom e-postmeddelandena kommer att raderas och du kan förlora åtkomst.
faq.question4: Hur länge varar en tillfällig e-post?
faq.answer4: Som standard varar tillfälliga e-postadresser på TempMailCentral i 10 minuter. Inloggade användare kan dock förlänga tiden upp till 30 dagar eller till och med spara adressen som en permanent brevlåda.
faq.answer5: Vissa webbplatser upprätthåller svartlistor över kända tillfälliga e-postdomäner. Även om TempMailCentral använder flera domäner för att minimera detta, kan vissa strikta webbplatser fortfarande upptäcka och blockera tillfälliga e-postadresser.
faq.question6: Behöver jag registrera mig för att använda temp mail?
faq.answer6: Ingen registrering krävs för att använda TempMailCentral. Besök bara webbplatsen så får du automatiskt en tillfällig e-postadress som du kan använda omedelbart.
faq.question7: Kan jag ta emot bilagor med temp mail?
faq.answer7: Ja, TempMailCentral stödjer mottagning av e-postbilagor. Du kan visa och ladda ner bilagor från e-postmeddelanden som skickas till din tillfälliga adress.
faq.answer8: Temp mail används vanligtvis för: registrering för gratis provperioder, undvika nyhetsbrevsspam, testa e-postfunktionalitet i applikationer, skydda din riktiga e-post från dataintrång, onlineshopping på opålitliga webbplatser och tillgång till engångsnedladdningar eller resurser.

meta.description: Learn how TempMailCentral protects your privacy. We don't store personal data, all emails auto-delete, and your privacy is our priority.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your privacy and handle your data
privacy.introduction: At TempMailCentral, privacy is our top priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our temporary email service. By using our service, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

dataCollection.title: Information We Collect
dataCollection.content:
We collect minimal information to provide our service:

• Technical Data: IP addresses, browser type, and device information for security and service improvement
• Usage Data: How you interact with our service to improve functionality
• Email Content: Temporarily stored emails that auto-delete after expiration
• Cookies: Essential cookies for service functionality

We do NOT collect:
• Personal identification information
• Payment information (our service is free)
• Your real email address
• Any data we don't absolutely need

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.content:
We use collected information for:

• Providing and maintaining our temporary email service
• Improving user experience and service functionality
• Detecting and preventing abuse, spam, and security threats
• Analyzing usage patterns to optimize performance
• Complying with legal obligations

We do NOT:
• Sell your data to third parties
• Use your data for advertising
• Share your information without your consent
• Store data longer than necessary

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing and Disclosure
dataSharing.content:
We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information. We may share data only in these limited cases:

• Legal Requirements: When required by law or to protect our rights
• Service Providers: Trusted partners who help operate our service (under strict confidentiality)
• Security: To prevent fraud, abuse, or security threats

All third-party service providers are bound by confidentiality agreements and are prohibited from using your information for any purpose other than providing services to us.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content:
We use cookies and similar technologies:

• Essential Cookies: Required for service functionality (cannot be disabled)
• Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how you use our service
• Preference Cookies: Remember your settings and preferences

You can control cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling essential cookies may limit service functionality.

We do NOT use:
• Advertising cookies
• Third-party tracking cookies
• Social media tracking pixels

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content:
We implement industry-standard security measures:

• Encryption: All data transmitted is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS
• Secure Infrastructure: Our servers use advanced security protocols
• Access Control: Limited access to data by authorized personnel only
• Regular Audits: Continuous monitoring and security assessments
• Auto-Deletion: Emails automatically delete after expiration

While we strive to protect your data, no internet transmission is 100% secure. Use our service at your own risk for non-sensitive communications.

emailRetention.title: Email Retention and Deletion
emailRetention.content:
Email retention policy:

• Temporary Emails: Auto-delete after 10 minutes by default
• Extended Emails: Delete based on your chosen extension period
• Permanent Mailboxes: Retain until you delete (for registered users)
• Deleted Content: Permanently removed from our systems

Once deleted, emails cannot be recovered. We do not maintain backups of temporary email content.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: privacy@tempmailcentral.com

meta.title: About Us - TempMailCentral
meta.description: Learn about TempMailCentral, the trusted temporary email service protecting privacy for over 500,000 users worldwide.

about.title: About TempMailCentral
about.subtitle: Protecting your privacy with secure, disposable email addresses since day one

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Our mission is simple: protect your privacy online. In a world where your email address is constantly requested, we believe you should have the freedom to maintain your privacy without sacrificing access to online services. TempMailCentral provides a fast, free, and secure way to use the internet without compromising your personal information.

highlight.title: Privacy First, Always
highlight.description: We built TempMailCentral on the principle that privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury. Every feature we add is designed with your privacy in mind.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide everything we do

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.description: Your privacy is non-negotiable. We don't sell data, track unnecessarily, or store information longer than needed.

simplicity.title: Simple & Fast
simplicity.description: No registration, no complications. Just instant, working email addresses when you need them.

accessibility.title: Free & Accessible
accessibility.description: Privacy protection should be available to everyone, everywhere. Our service is free and available in 20+ languages.

transparency.title: Transparent
transparency.description: We're honest about what we do, how we do it, and what limitations exist. No hidden terms or surprises.

story.title: How TempMailCentral Started
story.paragraph1: TempMailCentral was born from a simple frustration: giving out email addresses to websites that didn't need them. Every signup meant more spam, more tracking, and less privacy. We knew there had to be a better way.
story.paragraph2: We started by building a service for ourselves—a simple, fast way to get temporary email addresses without registration. As word spread, we realized others shared our concerns about online privacy. Today, we serve over 500,000 users worldwide who trust us to protect their privacy.
story.paragraph3: We've grown from a simple tool to a comprehensive privacy service, but our core mission remains the same: give people control over their digital privacy. We continue to improve our service, add new features, and expand to new languages—all while keeping privacy at the forefront of everything we do.
